what: Pure Node.js SMTP client. No npm. Uses net + tls + dns.resolveMx to send email directly to Gmail MX servers.
how: 1. dns.resolveMx('gmail.com') → get MX host. 2. net.connect(25, mx_host) → SMTP handshake. 3. EHLO, MAIL FROM, RCPT TO, DATA, content, QUIT.
test_command: node engine/gaia-smtp.js --to mok.kevin.c@gmail.com --subject 'lub-DUB' --body 'First direct email from Gaia'
warning: ISP may block outbound port 25. If blocked, use port 587 with TLS to a relay OR use the Outlook bridge.
outlook_bridge: Configure Outlook to connect to Gaia's IMAP/POP3 on the local network. Kevin reads mail IN Outlook but it's stored IN Gaia.
station_in_gaia: All mail lives in Gaia/mail/. Outlook/Thunderbird connects to 127.0.0.1:993 (IMAP). Kevin IS inside the cell.
